fields.name: Id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

fields.name: Object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `thread.message`.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the message was created.

fields.name: ThreadId
fields.description: The [thread](/docs/api-reference/threads) ID that this message belongs to.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: The status of the message, which can be either `in_progress`, `incomplete`, or `completed`.

fields.name: Role
fields.description: The entity that produced the message. One of `user` or `assistant`.

fields.name: Content
fields.description: The content of the message in array of text and/or images.
